title: scATAC-seq (microfluidics)
scope: Buenrostro 2015 microfluidic scATAC-seq implementation, represented by the Illumina schematic from cell suspension through pooled cell-indexed DNA libraries; not combinatorial indexing. One representative per-cell route is repeated before pooling. The left overview illustrates the assay target rather than a second workflow. Sequencing and downstream analyses are not depicted action blocks.

evidence.locator: [b00006], Main, what the DNA fragments represent
evidence.quote: Data from single cells recapitulate several characteristics of bulk ATAC-seq data, including fragment size periodicity corresponding to integer multiples of nucleosomes, and a strong enrichment of fragments within regions of accessible chromatin (Extended Data Fig. 2b,c).

evidence.locator: [b00007], Main, sparse sampling of accessible elements
evidence.quote: For example, within a typical single cell we estimate a total of 9.4% of promoters are represented in a typical scATAC-seq library (Extended Data Fig. 3). The sparse nature of scATAC-seq data makes analysis of cellular variation at individual regulatory elements impractical.

properties.name: Accessibility representation
properties.definition: What the physical DNA library can report about the chromatin from which its genomic inserts originated.
properties.value: Genomic DNA inserts are enriched for accessible chromatin regions; their genomic origin and retained cell indexes support per-cell accessibility mapping after sequencing. Representation is sparse rather than a complete inventory of accessible sites.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned card explicitly associates the microfluidic diagram with Buenrostro et al. 2015, whose full text describes individual Fluidigm C1 capture, Tn5 adapter insertion, on-IFC PCR, collected-library cell indexing, and pooling. All five depicted action blocks apply to this implementation. The broad amplification block includes the primary-supported on-chip/off-chip interface; the final DNA lines are a physical library, not measurement data. No alternative or independent experimental branch is depicted.

evidence.locator: [b00011], Introduction, relationship to ATAC-seq and study method (full-text passage)
evidence.quote: In this study, we modified scDNase-seq method to achieve de novo genome-wide DHS mapping using as few as 30 cells. Using this low-input DNase-seq (liDNase-seq) method, we have generated DHS maps of mouse preimplantation embryos from 1-cell to the morula stage, revealing the dynamics of chromatin accessibility during mouse preimplantation development process.
evidence.rationale: This is an unshown DNase-based adaptation. Its discussion of single-cell ATAC-seq is background, not evidence that its liDNase-seq workflow is another target of the assigned microfluidic schematic.

corrections.diagram_observation: The shaded "Microfluidics device" ends after "Fragmented and primed". The only amplification caption, "Amplify with cell-specific barcodes", lies outside that enclosure and precedes pooling; no on-chip PCR substep is drawn.
corrections.primary_statement: Buenrostro 2015 reports transposition and PCR on the IFC, followed by library collection and further PCR with cell-identifying barcoded primers, then pooling. The composite amplification operation therefore spans on-chip PCR and collected-library indexing; its output and downstream flows retain this order. The drawing does not justify placing all amplification outside the device.
